business_summary: Beijing Quanshi World Online Network Information Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides internet marketing and enterprise-level SaaS promotion services in China. It provides internet marketing solutions comprising Tencent Ads, a social advertising marketing platform; 360 Smart Business that covers user scenarios to provide enterprises with full life cycle services; iQiyi, which provides an online promotion solution; Toutiao, a general information platform; Xiaohongshu, a lifestyle content platform; and Sohu, an internet media, search, and online game group. The company also offers enterprise-level SaaS promotion services consisting of Qidian Customer Service, an omnichannel lead generation and customer service platform for sales and customer service departments; Enterprise Collaboration, an office collaboration platform; WeChat Work, an office platform for enterprises; Aike CRM, which focuses on sales management for small and medium-sized enterprises; and Tencent Enterprise Email, a corporate email service for enterprise users. In addition, it provides value-added services comprising Nebula Astar, a one-stop new media integrated marketing tool; integrated upgrade services; and offline performance marketing tools for app promotion. Further, it is involved in the design, production, acting as agency, and publishing of advertisements; technology promotion and transfer; conference and exhibition advertising; film distribution; radio and television program production; technical consultation, development, and exchange; Internet information; and digital technology activities. Beijing Quanshi World Online Network Information Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
